goal: Implement the shared hybrid domain contracts, conversation/sync coordinators, provider runtime foundation, and Python online API without depending on Android Room or Compose.
non_goals: Do not modify mobile-native/app or mobile-native/feature.
Do not modify Room entities, DAOs, migrations, or protocol parsers.
Do not upload local chat or source正文 by default.
Do not revert unrelated user or worker changes.
acceptance_criteria: Shared model and Repository contracts compile and have invariant tests.
Independent TurnRuns can run concurrently while explicit dependent follow-ups wait.
Retry attempts cannot be overwritten by older late results.
Python activity and sync writes are idempotent.
Local execution does not require the Python service.
verification_expectations: Run core:model, core:domain, and core:llm tests.
Report any required shared Gradle changes without editing controller-owned settings files.
